checked_routes.result: The official Characters route was opened, but the accessible extraction did not expose exact character names that could be mapped safely to the 11 campaign identities.
The official site identifies Four Leaf Studios and links its Characters, Samples, and Download sections; the landing-page text does not establish exact campaign identity mappings.
The official Steam listing identifies Katawa Shoujo and Four Leaf Studios and describes five main character routes, but does not name the exact 11 campaign identities.

notes: Three distinct first-party routes were checked. Exact tag-to-character mappings remain unestablished; this is partial research progress, not negative evidence or campaign exhaustion.
